note: Specified-book replay of the user's clarified geometry: TP/SL are percent of the $10k account, not of EURUSD price. 3 lots fixed, TP $20, SL $100, halt -$300. NOT a retune of the 192-config v1 screen. Frozen before this search's metrics. promote=false live_go=false. Expected SCREEN_FAIL: at 3 lots, $20 TP = 6.7 points vs median spread 12 points; round-trip friction 22 points x $3 = $66 > $20 target.

data.source: same dump as eurusd_ny_scalp_develop_v1 — not a new peek

clock.rule: same as v1: server = ET+7h, per-bar America/New_York localization

session.friday_cutoff: no new entries at or after 14:00 ET Friday

book.friction_at_median_spread: 22 pt x $3 = $66 round-trip vs $20 TP — TP sits inside the spread
book.rejected_six_lots: 6 lots was the original seed; 3 lots is the user-requested alternative. Arithmetic is the same shape: 6 lots TP = 3.3 pt (worse).

risk.daily_halt_rule: no NEW entries once realized day PnL <= -300 (three full $100 stops)

fills_and_exits.signal_to_fill: close of i, fill open of i+1, same ET day
fills_and_exits.exit: usd: TP $20 / SL $100 in account dollars, converted to points via lots x $1/pt

holdout.holdout_rule: NEVER used for selection. This search does not select — it replays one specified book across the three frozen families x one_per_day.
holdout.peek_status: Same window as v1. See v1 lock peek_status.

grid.structure: 3 frozen families x one_per_day {true,false} x 1 usd exit (TP $20 / SL $100)
grid.ranking: develop-only, same score_row as v1; holdout scored after rank freezes

null_calibration.procedure: same as v1: within-ET-day circular phase rotation, 10 seeds, full 6-config grid per seed
null_calibration.gate: develop winner median_trade_day_pct >= max_null_best + 0.5 * 0.01, if any winner exists
